lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular spots are arranged in a structured grid posterior to the gill region, forming three primary longitudinal rows and at least six visible vertical columns within the mid-flank region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of increased pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of spots, positioning individual high-luminance blobs at the intersections to form a nodal grid structure.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal ridge is visible along the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a sharp transition from high pixel intensity on the dorsal side to a shaded gradient on the ventral side.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin displays a dense field of small, high-luminance spots, which are notably smaller and more closely packed than the primary spots on the lateral flank.
